windows.60: Over the past 60 days, visitors have noted issues with the food service at the Theodore Roosevelt Presidential Library, particularly regarding limited menu options and long wait times. Several reviews mentioned that the food quality did not meet expectations, with specific complaints about the preparation and variety of offerings. Wait times for ordering were also a problem, with at least one report of a significant delay due to kitchen backups. While the overall rating remains positive, these operational concerns around food and service should be addressed to improve the visitor experience.
windows.90: Visitor reviews over the last 90 days indicate ongoing issues with the food service at the Theodore Roosevelt Presidential Library. Many guests found the menu limited and the food quality below expectations, with complaints about portion sizes, pricing, and preparation. Wait times and service reliability were also noted as problems, including periods when the kitchen was not taking orders despite advertised options. While the library itself receives positive remarks, the café experience detracts from the overall visit and needs attention.
